conditions: skill: same task plus frozen development skill
model_and_settings: Both writer agents inherited the same parent model/settings; exact external model ID and sampling parameters are not exported by the agent tool.
generations: One independent response per condition/case; four cases, eight outputs; no revision after judging
access: Writers instructed to read only writer-safe briefs; skill arm additionally allowed frozen skill/development references. No original source lookup, web or grading key access.
budgets: Same requested abstract word range and three introduction paragraphs; token, wall-time and context sizes were not equalized or uniformly instrumented.
rendering: No manuscript compilation/rendering; source/data diagnostics only
blinding: A/B independently randomized per case, seed29; mapping withheld from judge until saved judgments
harness_correction: After writer freeze, source-reference mapping validation and stable case ordering were strengthened. No writing rule, statistic, rubric or candidate changed.
limitations: Four selected cases, one generation and one judge; no statistical superiority, productivity or acceptance-rate claim.
